prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ canonicalizeLabel, buildLabelIndex }`.

`canonicalizeLabel(label)` accepts a string, removes leading and trailing whitespace, converts ASCII letters to lowercase, replaces each maximal run of characters other than ASCII letters or digits with one underscore, and removes any resulting leading or trailing underscore. If the result is empty, it must throw `TypeError`; non-string input must also throw `TypeError`.

`buildLabelIndex(labels)` accepts an array of strings and returns a new null-prototype object whose enumerable keys are canonical labels and whose values are the original strings. Process labels from left to right, so key enumeration follows first appearance order. If two different positions produce the same key, throw `TypeError` instead of overwriting either entry. An empty array returns an empty null-prototype object. The input array must not be mutated or retained by the result. Invalid inputs throw `TypeError`. Export using `module.exports` only.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
